definition: the business of making people notice products
description: A sunny city street lined with brownstone buildings and black fire escapes. A young man dressed in a huge hot-dog costume, with a bun, a sausage and a yellow mustard stripe, jogs on the spot grinning and points a big foam pointing hand towards a steel food cart. At the cart a young man in a blue shirt and beige trousers laughs as a young woman in a burgundy jacket hands him a hot dog, and he takes it. Long shadows fall across the pavement.

taps.target: the man in the blue shirt

taps.phrase: to hand over a hot dog

de.answer: Sie reicht dem Mann einen Hotdog.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Le está dando un perrito caliente al hombre.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle tend un hot-dog à l'homme.
fr.question: Que fait la femme ?
